check_title: Retrieval-time AI crawler blocked in robots.txt
criteria: PRESENT if any retrieval/hybrid-class agent (GPTBot, PerplexityBot, etc.) has Disallow on root '/'. Severity critical. Silent if only training-class agents (e.g. CCBot) are blocked, or the block is on a path other than root.
label: ABSENT
notes: Only training-class agents (GPTBot, ClaudeBot, meta-externalagent) are Disallow'd at root, per site-evidence-collector's own agent classification. No retrieval-class agent (OAI-SearchBot, ChatGPT-User, PerplexityBot, Claude-Web/User, Claude-SearchBot, Perplexity-User) is named anywhere in robots.txt.

criteria: PRESENT if a training-class agent has Disallow on root AND no retrieval-class agent is blocked (else CHK-D-001 fires instead and this is silent). Severity low, informational -- blocking training crawlers is frequently deliberate policy, not a defect.
label: PRESENT
notes: GPTBot, ClaudeBot and meta-externalagent (all training-class) are blocked at root; no retrieval-class agent is blocked, so this fires instead of CHK-D-001.

check_title: Raw-fetch content gap vs. rendered DOM
criteria: PRESENT (critical) if raw HTML has no h1 AND <50 words of main text, while rendered DOM has >=200 words. medium if h1 present but >=60% of text is render-only. low if 20-60% render-only. Silent below 20% gap or if noscript has >50 words.
label: UNMEASURABLE
notes: No rendered evidence captured in this bundle (rendered=[]). Raw homepage isn't sparse either (h1 present, 2538 words), so the one-sided static re-derivation (D-015) doesn't fire -- neither branch of the rule can be evaluated.

check_title: Thin main content (<200 words after boilerplate removal)
criteria: PRESENT (medium) per page if main_text_words < 200 after boilerplate removal. Excludes page_type in {contact, login, home} -- home added Stage C, D-022, since a homepage is framing, not content. Silent if CHK-D-003 fired on this page as a JS-SPA homepage.
label: PRESENT
notes: Also under 200: Oct calendar (159 words), Alerts/AlmaLinux (167), Alerts/Fedora (174). NOTE: these are calendar/alerts index pages, not article content -- arguably navigational/utility rather than 'thin content' in the intended sense, but they aren't in the check's literal exclusion set {home, contact, login}, so the shipped check fires on them regardless. Flagging as a borderline call, not deciding it for you.

check_title: Absent or generic headings on long pages (>500 words)
criteria: PRESENT (low) if no h2/h3 present, or headings are generic ('More', 'Details') rather than descriptive, on pages with >500 words. Excludes legal/FAQ/minimal-content page types.
label: ABSENT
notes: Only qualifying page after excluding legal/FAQ is home (2538 words): 21 headings, all descriptive article titles, none generic.

check_title: Missing explicit entity definition in first 300 words
criteria: PRESENT (medium if absent on both, low if absent on one) if no sentence in the first 300 words names the organisation + its category + its function. Silent if the <title> already states org name + category, or if CHK-D-007 fires with complete Org JSON-LD.
label: ABSENT
notes: First sentence of the homepage: 'LWN.net is a reader-supported news site dedicated to producing the best coverage from within the Linux and free software development communities.' -- names org, category, and function explicitly.

criteria: PRESENT (low; capped from medium in Stage C, D-022 -- absence is the open web's majority condition per WDC 2024, not a differentiator) if no @type:Organization JSON-LD block exists on the homepage, OR one exists but is missing 'name' or 'url'. N/A on personal/hobby/portfolio archetypes.
label: PRESENT
notes: No JSON-LD of any kind on the homepage, let alone an Organization block.

criteria: PRESENT (medium) if >=2 pages have no rel=canonical, or any page's canonical points cross-domain (not a same-brand redirect target). low if missing on exactly 1 page. Passes if self-referential, or a valid alternate-domain consolidation, or a pagination canonical.
label: PRESENT
notes: canonical.href is null on all 9 sampled pages -- no rel=canonical anywhere, well above the 2-page medium threshold.

where_to_look: sampled pages, up to 20 links checked
criteria: PRESENT (low) if any checked internal link returns 4xx/5xx. Links already in links.skipped[] (robots-disallowed, fragment, mailto:, budget-cut) don't count -- they were never checked, not found broken.
label: ABSENT
notes: Of 20 checked links: three return 403, three return 429, rest are 200. Zero genuine 404/500. NOTE: 403 is explicitly exempted by the check's own FP guard (bot-challenge, not_determinable); 429 is NOT explicitly exempted in the stated rule and is technically a 4xx code. Graded these as not genuinely broken (rate-limiting, not dead links) -- flagging in case you read the literal rule differently.

check_title: No definition/numeric fact/comparison on the page
where_to_look: informational pages, excl. home/contact/login (recommendation-only since Stage C)
criteria: RECOMMENDATION-ONLY since Stage C (D-022) -- never a finding, regardless of state. 'PRESENT' (i.e. flagged) if the page's text has none of: a definitional sentence ('X is a/an/the Y'), a number+unit, or an explicit comparison word ('than', 'vs', 'faster than', etc.). Silent if CHK-D-004 already fired on this page.
label: PRESENT
evidence: Recent AlmaLinux security alerts (3017 alerts total)
notes: No definitional sentence, no number+recognised-unit match, no comparison word found on this page's text.

check_title: Pronoun-saturated key claims, no explicit antecedent
criteria: PRESENT (low) if >60% of sentences open with a pronoun (He/She/It/They/We/This/These/etc.) with no preceding explicit mention in the same passage. Excludes narrative/blog page types.
label: ABSENT
notes: Home page's opening sentences explicitly name their subject ('LWN.net is...', 'Tiered-memory systems are...'), not pronoun-led.

check_title: Missing date signal on time-sensitive content
criteria: PRESENT (low) if a time-sensitive page has no plausible date (within last 5 years) in body, meta tags, or Last-Modified header. NEVER raised on evergreen pages -- when in doubt the classifier treats a page as evergreen. Silent if a valid Last-Modified header exists even with no visible date.
label: ABSENT
notes: Alerts pages carry real visible dates (2026-09-03 etc.). Home's article teasers show 'Posted Sep 3, 2026 14:11 UTC' in the body text -- NOTE: the bundle's own dates.visible_dates field came back empty for home (a collector extraction miss, not ground truth); graded against what's actually visible in the raw text. Calendar pages treated as evergreen/navigational, not time-sensitive content that goes stale -- flagging that read in case you disagree.

criteria: PRESENT (low) if word-trigram Jaccard similarity is >0.8 across 3+ sampled inner pages. Excludes legitimate variant pages (size/color) and legal/ToS pages, where near-identical text is expected.
label: ABSENT
notes: Actually computed word-trigram Jaccard across the 4 Alerts pages (Alerts/, AlmaLinux, Fedora, SUSE): pairwise scores ranged 0.007-0.257, all well under the 0.8 threshold. They look similar by template/layout but the actual text content (package names, IDs, dates) differs enough that this doesn't fire.

check_title: No declared identity anchors (sameAs / outbound profile links)
criteria: PRESENT (medium) if zero sameAs JSON-LD entries AND zero outbound profile links (LinkedIn/GitHub/Wikipedia/etc.) appear on home or about. Any single resolvable anchor of either kind passes. N/A on personal/hobby/portfolio archetypes.
label: PRESENT
evidence: anchors.declared = [], outbound_profile_links = [] on every sampled page
notes: Zero declared sameAs entries and zero outbound profile links anywhere on the site.

where_to_look: each declared anchor URL (bounded HEAD requests)
criteria: PRESENT (high if all anchors fail, medium if some fail) if a declared anchor (from CHK-D-025) returns 404/410. 401/403/429 is bot-blocked, NOT broken -- not_determinable, never a finding for that anchor. N/A if CHK-D-025 found zero anchors to check.
label: N/A
notes: CHK-D-025 found zero declared anchors to check, so this check has nothing to evaluate -- fires instead of this one, per its own guard.

where_to_look: JSON-LD + footer + contact page, >=2 instances required
criteria: PRESENT (medium for name/legal-name conflict, low for phone/address only) if the same attribute appears in >=2 genuinely different forms across pages, after normalizing whitespace/punctuation and legal-entity suffixes (Ltd/Limited/LLC/Inc/GmbH etc. are equivalent) and international phone prefixes. Silent if fewer than 2 comparable instances exist.
label: UNMEASURABLE
notes: Only one genuine phone instance observed (FAQ page, +1 720 310 0640) -- fewer than 2 comparable instances to judge consistency against. (The calendar pages' contact_signals.phone field shows '2003 2004 2005', which is a false-positive regex match on a copyright-year string, not a real phone number -- excluded from the count.)

criteria: PRESENT (high, sub-checks a-e) per page for: (a) missing lang on <html>; (b) img with alt===null (NOT alt=="", which is correct for decorative images); (c) link/button with no accessible text; (d) form control with no label/aria-label; (e) iframe with no title. (f) contrast ratio <4.5:1 normal / <3:1 large text -- medium, not_determinable if no rendered evidence.
label: PRESENT
notes: (a)-(e) checked on home page: all clean. (b) failure found on calendar pages instead: 22 images missing alt entirely on the Aug page, 46 on the Oct page (nav icons: left-arrow/right-arrow/calsquare). (f) contrast checked via DevTools Accessibility pane on home body text: white-on-black or black-on-white depending on theme, 21:1, clean.

criteria: PRESENT (high) if viewport meta has user-scalable=no or maximum-scale<2. medium if viewport meta is missing entirely, or horizontal overflow at 375px. minimum-scale=1 is NOT a zoom restriction.
label: ABSENT
notes: viewport meta present and correct (width=device-width, initial-scale=1) on home/calendar/alerts. Checked overflow at 375px in DevTools device toolbar: no horizontal scrollbar, everything fit.

check_title: Standalone tap targets below 24x24 CSS px
criteria: PRESENT (medium) if any standalone (non-inline-text) interactive element is <24x24 CSS px, per WCAG 2.2 SC 2.5.8. Silent if adjacent-target spacing is >=24px (spacing exception) or the element is an inline text link.
label: ABSENT
notes: Checked standalone icons/buttons at 375px via DevTools element picker; no violation found.

criteria: PRESENT (medium) if >10% of links on a page use text like 'click here', 'read more', 'learn more', 'details', etc., AND have no descriptive aria-label.
label: ABSENT
notes: Zero matches for click here / read more / learn more / details across all 9 sampled pages.

criteria: PRESENT (high) if an overlay covers >=50% of viewport AND body scroll is locked at page load. medium if >=50% coverage without scroll lock. Silent if dismissible_hint is 'cookie' or 'age' (legal-compliance overlays are not defects).
label: ABSENT
notes: Hard-refreshed and watched load; no modal, no reload prompt, nothing blocking the page.

check_title: Blank first paint, no noscript/skeleton fallback
criteria: PRESENT (high) if raw HTTP fetch has <50 words AND noscript has <50 words AND rendered DOM has >=200 words. medium if raw <200 words but noscript has a meaningful (>=50 word) fallback. Duplicates CHK-D-003's mechanism deliberately; the orchestrator defers this finding to CHK-D-003 when both fire on the same site.
label: ABSENT
notes: Homepage raw HTML alone contains 2538 words of real content, far above the sparse threshold.

check_title: Autoplaying media with sound, no pause control
criteria: PRESENT (medium) if a <video>/<audio> element has autoplay=true, muted=false, AND controls=false. 'video autoplay muted' is correct and NOT flagged.
label: ABSENT
notes: Zero <video>/<audio> elements found on any of the 9 sampled pages.

criteria: RECOMMENDATION-ONLY since Stage C (D-022) -- never a finding, always low severity if flagged. 'PRESENT' (i.e. flagged) if >=3 images/iframes lack width+height attrs AND css aspect-ratio (excludes responsive <picture> elements).
label: PRESENT
notes: Site logo + lcorner logo images have no width/height/aspect-ratio and repeat on every page -- roughly 18 instances across the 9 sampled pages.

criteria: PRESENT (high) if a page has zero <h1> elements. medium if <main> landmark is missing, or a heading level is skipped (e.g. h2 straight to h4). Multiple h1 is NOT a violation (removed Stage B, D-020 -- WCAG permits multiple h1 under HTML5 sectioning).
label: PRESENT
notes: FAQ page heading levels jump from h1 straight to h3, skipping level 2 entirely. All other 8 pages have a clean sequence and at least one <main> + one <h1>.

criteria: RECOMMENDATION-ONLY, always -- never a finding at any severity. 'PRESENT' (i.e. flagged) if a commercial/news site lacks detectable contact info, org name in footer, HTTPS, or byline dates on articles. N/A on documentation/brochure/personal archetypes.
label: ABSENT
notes: Only applicable if graded against the curated news_editorial archetype (the automated classifier said 'unknown' -- your call which to use). If applicable: email + phone present (FAQ page), HTTPS site-wide, and footer reads 'Copyright (c) 2026, Eklektix, Inc.' on every page checked -- org name present, contra the bundle's own org_name_footer=None extraction miss.
